sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the mucous membranes and the liver. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the respiratory organs. There is a general feeling of heaviness and soreness in the liver region. The patient is often a stout person with a sedentary lifestyle. There is a marked tendency to portal congestion and a feeling of chilliness.
sections.Mind: Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Fears death. Aversion to work.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo on rising. Scalp feels tight.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision. Sensation of a film over the eyes.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Nosebleed.
sections.Face: Expression of pain and anxiety. Pale and sallow. Sensation of a cobweb on the face.
sections.Mouth: Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky. Foul breath.
sections.Throat: Dryness and rawness in the throat. Swollen and sore. Sensation of a lump in the throat. Hawking of mucus.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Eructations.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Rumbling. Flatulence. Sharp pains in the region of the liver.
sections.Rectum: Constipation. Stool large and hard. Haemorrhoids, with burning and itching. Anus feels sore and raw.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Hoarseness.
sections.Back: Stiffness and aching in the back. Sensitiveness of the spine to touch.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Trembling of the hands. Numbness and tingling.
sections.Skin: Itching and burning. Dry and scaly. Eruptions like miliary rash.
sections.Modalities: Worse in the morning and from cold air. Better from open air and moderate motion.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Ammonium carbonicum; Lachesis; Rhus toxicodendron.
